gaps.where: A company's page (Contacts → Companies → a company): header phone/email/address, Details tab (Phone, other numbers, Email, other emails, Website, Address, other addresses, Assigned to, Source, Created, Notes), Fields, People · N in Relationships, its Leads and Tasks tabs; and the Companies tab columns (Contact, Tags, People, Open leads)
gaps.gap: No tool reads a company in full. get_record_details for a company returns only name, archived, lookedAfterBy, relationships and files. search_customers returns a company's id, name and phone, at most 3. Some of it can be reached: read_search_everything, or read_search_kind with kind 'companies' and the company's name, returns the main phone, email, address (street and city), people count and open-lead count, and read_search_kind with kind 'contacts' and the company's name finds the people there. Nothing returns the website, other numbers, emails or addresses, notes, source, tags, the company's own fields, created date, the named list of people from company.get, or the company's leads. list_leads has no companyId, though lead.list takes one.
gaps.fix: In get_record_details, when recordType is company (tools-inbox-crm.ts about()), also return from company.get: email, phone, website, address, otherPhones, otherEmails and otherAddresses (each with its label), notes, source, tags (names), createdAt, fields (fieldId, label, type, value via customValueText over custom_field.list {entity:'company'}), people [{id, name, phone, email, archived}], and openLeads from lead.list {companyId, status:'open'} (id, title, stage, value). Add companyId to list_leads in tools.ts:88-101 and pass it through in tools-read.ts list_leads.

gaps.where: Contacts list: All / Leads / Clients segmented filter, Assigned to anyone picker, Client badge, Open leads and Last activity columns, company/address line; the Companies tab list
gaps.gap: list_customers passes only q, tagId, withoutTagId, limit and cursor to person.list. It can't filter to leads or clients, by who a customer is assigned to, or by company, although person.list takes standing, assignedUserId and companyId. It returns id, name, phone, email and tag names, with no client flag, open-lead count, last activity, company or address. No tool lists companies: search_customers stops at 3 and needs words; read_search_kind (which takes standing) needs at least 2 characters to search; find_archived lists only archived companies; crm.summary gives only the counts.
gaps.fix: Add standing ('lead'|'client'), assignedUserId, companyId, includeArchived and sort ('name'|'recent') to list_customers (tools.ts:63-75), and pass them to person.list in tools-contacts.ts:77-91. Return client, openLeads, lastActivityAt, company {id, name} and address.city. Add a list_companies tool on company.list (q, tagId, assignedUserId, standing, includeArchived, limit, cursor) returning id, name, phone, email, website, tags, peopleCount, openLeads, client and nextCursor.

gaps.where: A customer's, company's, lead's and record's page: Log call (and the Note sheet's Note / Call / Visit choice, When, Related lead, Set a next action from this)
gaps.gap: add_note always calls activity.log with kind 'note'. It takes no occurredAt and no customRecordId. The Assistant can't log a call or a visit, back-date an entry, or put a note on a pet, vehicle or property, although activity.log takes all three and the places map tells it to use 'Note or Log call'. The only part already covered: it can attach the note to a lead together with a person.
gaps.fix: Add kind ('note'|'call'|'visit', default 'note'), occurredAt (when, optional) and customRecordId to add_note (tools.ts:1163-1174), or rename it log_activity. Pass them to activity.log in tools-write.ts:195-206, title the done card 'Call on …' or 'Visit on …', and link a record with recordHref. Keep it auto with Undo, as activity.delete already undoes it (tools-write.ts:928).

gaps.where: A lead (web full page and side sheet, phone lead screen): next action time, Lost: reason · date, Won · date, Value, Assigned to, Last contact, Expected close, Source, Tags, “N days in stage”, its company, archived
gaps.gap: get_lead and list_leads use leadResult, which drops nextActionAt, nextActionOverdue, lostReason, lostAt, wonAt, lastContactAt, expectedCloseOn, source, tags, stageEnteredAt, company and archivedAt, although lead.get and lead.list return them. Some of it can be reached: read_lead_board returns the full lead cards, but for one pipeline, without archived leads, and cut off after 16,000 characters (about 20 leads). read_timeline_list on a lead shows the 'Lost: <reason>' line with its date. Neither is the natural path for 'when is the follow-up due?', and get_lead answers with the next action but not its time.
gaps.fix: In tools-read.ts:210-222 leadResult, add: nextActionAt (formatted with when()), nextActionOverdue, lostReason, lostAt, wonAt, lastContactAt, expectedCloseOn, source, tags (names), daysInStage (from stageEnteredAt), company {id, name} and archived. Widen the LeadItem interface (tools-read.ts:136-151) to match, and update get_lead's description ('…next action and when, last contact, expected close, source, tags, why it was lost…').

gaps.where: A customer's page: Details tab rows Other addresses (with labels), Calls from us (Not asked / Agreed in writing (where) / Doesn’t want calls), Created and the “Customer since” badge, the Archived badge and the “merged into … Open (name)” notice; phone head line (customer since · source) and the possible-duplicate banner
gaps.gap: Archived is already readable: get_record_details for a person returns archived, and find_archived lists archived customers with the date. get_customer still leaves out otherAddresses (with labels), callConsent (consent and where it's written), createdAt (Customer since), mergedInto (the record a duplicate was merged into) and the company's id, all of which person.get returns. The Assistant can't say whether someone agreed to calls, give their second address, say how long they've been a customer, or point from a merged duplicate to the record kept.
gaps.fix: In tools-read.ts get_customer (313-327), add otherAddresses [{label, address line}], calls {consent: 'not asked'|'agreed in writing'|'doesn’t want calls', where: callConsent.source}, customerSince: createdAt, archived: !!archivedAt, mergedInto {id, name}, and company {id, name} in place of the bare name. Add these fields to the PersonItem interface (tools-read.ts:121-135).

gaps.where: Edit lead dialog (⋯ → Edit details on a lead): Title, Expected close, Source
gaps.gap: update_lead takes only assigneeUserId, value, nextAction and nextActionAt. It can't rename a lead or change its Expected close or Source, although lead.update takes title, expectedCloseOn and source, and the places map tells it 'Change its value, owner or close date: ⋯, then Edit details'. A nextActionAt on its own is refused. The model can work around that by sending the current nextAction text again.
gaps.fix: Add title (text 160), expectedCloseOn (YYYY-MM-DD, nullable) and source (max 80, nullable) to update_lead (tools.ts:1297-1308). In tools-write.ts updateLead, add card rows Title, Expected close and Source (before → after) and pass them to lead.update. When only nextActionAt is given, call lead.set_next_action with the lead's current nextAction text, and refuse only when the lead has none.

gaps.where: New lead dialog (Lead button on a person's or company's page, Pipeline → New lead): Who is it for? (person or company), Pipeline, Next action + When, Expected close, Source
gaps.gap: create_lead needs a personId, so it can't open a lead for a company, although lead.create takes a companyId. It also leaves out the dialog's next-action time, Expected close and Source. Correction: the New lead dialog doesn't set tags. Additional bug: create_lead's commit sends stageId without pipelineId. lead.create then takes the first pipeline and refuses a stage from any other, so a lead can't be opened in a second pipeline, even though the card shows that stage.
gaps.fix: In tools.ts:1282-1295, make personId optional and add companyId (exactly one required), nextActionAt (when), expectedCloseOn (date) and source. In tools-write.ts createLead (672-735), read the company's name for the card, find the stage's pipeline and pass pipelineId, and pass companyId, nextActionAt, expectedCloseOn and source to lead.create.

gaps.where: A company's page: Details tab → Fields → Edit (the business's own company fields)
gaps.gap: No tool sets or reads a company's own fields. manage_company has no field values. manage_record 'change' runs record.set_fields only with recordType 'custom_record', and update_customer only with 'person'. get_record_details for a company returns no fields.
gaps.fix: Add values (field id → value, null clears it) to manage_company 'change' (tools-inbox-crm.ts:138-160). Check them with valueLines against custom_field.list {entity:'company'} and run record.set_fields {recordType:'company'} in the commit. Return the company's fields (fieldId, label, type, value) from get_record_details (crm-1).

gaps.where: Edit details (person and company): Add another address with its label, Make main for a number/email/address; company's Add another phone / email
gaps.gap: For a person, 'Make main' on a number or email is already possible: update_customer can set phone or email, removeOtherPhones/removeOtherEmails and addOtherPhones/addOtherEmails (with labels) in one call. What's missing: update_customer can't add, remove, relabel or make main a person's other addresses (otherAddresses), and manage_company can't touch a company's other phones, emails or addresses at all, although company.update takes otherPhones, otherEmails and otherAddresses.
gaps.fix: Add addOtherAddresses [{line1, line2, city, state, postalCode, label}] and removeOtherAddresses to update_customer, built as tools-contacts.ts:610-660 builds the phone and email lists. Add addOtherPhones, removeOtherPhones, addOtherEmails, removeOtherEmails, addOtherAddresses and removeOtherAddresses to manage_company, with card rows 'Other numbers', 'Other emails' and 'Other addresses'.

gaps.where: Details tab → Fields (fields marked to show when empty, choice fields shown by their label)
gaps.gap: update_customer's description tells the model to take field ids 'from get_customer', and its own refusal sends it back there (tools-contacts.ts:707). get_customer lists only fields that already have a value, with the raw stored value, no type, and no choice labels. An empty field (gate code, account number) has no id the model is told about. get_settings with area fields does read custom_field.list, but nothing points the model there.
gaps.fix: In tools-read.ts get_customer (301-311), always read custom_field.list {entity:'person'} and return every field as {id, name, type, choices (value and label), value: customValueText(field, custom[id]) or null}. Also change update_customer's description to 'by field id, from get_customer (every field, empty ones too)'.

gaps.where: A lead's full page: Qualification card (the AI teammate's qualifying answers, status, the questions still missing)
gaps.gap: lead.get returns lead.qualification, but get_lead drops it in leadResult. No other Assistant source reads it. The timeline gets only a 'lead_qualified' line, with the lead's title, once it's qualified. The Assistant can't say whether a lead is qualified, not a fit or in progress, what the customer answered, or which questions are still missing.
gaps.fix: In tools-read.ts get_lead (376-399), return qualification: status; answers [{question (from ai_teammate.get config.qualify.questions by id), answer, by: 'AI teammate' or the person's name, at}]; missing (the question texts); notAFit. Mention qualification in get_lead's description.

gaps.where: Tasks tab on a company's page and on a record's page (New task), and every record's Tasks tab including done tasks
gaps.gap: create_task takes only personId and leadId, so it can't put a task on a company or on a pet, vehicle or property, although task.create takes companyId and customRecordId. list_tasks always asks for status 'open' and has no person, lead, company or record filter. Its rows give only the person's name, not the lead, company or record, although task.list takes all those filters and returns them.
gaps.fix: Add companyId and customRecordId to create_task (tools.ts:1129-1143) and pass them in tools-write.ts create_task. Add personId, leadId, companyId, customRecordId and status ('open'|'done'|'all', default open) to list_tasks (tools.ts:132-142) and pass them in tools-read.ts:440-446. Return each task's lead.title, company.name, customRecord (name, kind), notes and doneAt.

gaps.where: Files tab (customer, company, lead, record): each file's “Signed · kept” lock, opening it, Download
gaps.gap: No Assistant read says whether a file is locked ('Signed · kept'): get_record_details drops locked, although file.list returns it. Opening a file is partly covered: read_search_everything with the file's name returns a path to the file on its record's Files tab (?tab=files&file=<id>), but it's a path, not a full link, and get_record_details gives no link at all.
gaps.fix: In get_record_details' files (tools-inbox-crm.ts:1910-1917), add locked: f.locked (and the words 'Signed and kept: it can’t be deleted'). Add href: the record's page (pageOf) + '?tab=files&file=<id>', made a full link from the web app's address as the commits' webUrl is, or return a list card with those hrefs.

gaps.where: Files tab ⋯ → Remove (shown only to people with Delete files, files.delete)
gaps.gap: delete_file runs file.delete, which removes the file for good (no Deleted bin; the worker deletes the stored object, and its own card says it 'can’t be brought back'). That breaks the owner's settled rule that the Assistant never deletes anything for good (docs/operations.md, settings-map's Deleted bin handover, and the public site's 'It never deletes anything for good'). It's also offered with records.write, while the screen shows Remove only with files.delete. Correction: the database's refusal reaches the person as plain words ('Only the person who added this file can delete it…'), not a raw error, but only after Confirm. A member who uploaded a file can also delete it through the Assistant although the screen hides Remove from them.
gaps.fix: Add 'file.delete': 'deleting a file for good, which stays the person’s (the owner, 2026-10-26)' to NEVER_FOR_THE_ASSISTANT. Remove delete_file from tools-inbox-crm.ts (core 249-260 and worker 2266-2300, plus inboxCrmConfirmTools and inboxCrmStepLabels), and remove the places-map canChange line 'delete a file on their record'. Have the Assistant point to 'their page, Files tab, ⋯ beside the file, Remove'.

gaps.where: A record's own page (Contacts → a kind's tab → a pet, vehicle or property)
gaps.gap: AssistantPageRecord's types are person, company, lead, conversation, appointment, workflow and workflow_run, and RECORD_ROUTES has no customers/records. On a record's page (/customers/records/<id>), the panel is told 'No customer, lead or appointment is on screen', so 'this', 'add a note to this' or 'who owns this dog?' can't be tied to the record.
gaps.fix: Add 'custom_record' to AssistantPageRecord.type (schemas/assistant.ts:319-330) and ['custom_record','customers/records'] to RECORD_ROUTES (words.ts:413-420). In context.ts pageLabel, read custom_record.get and label it '<name> (<kind singular>)'. In prompt.ts pageLines, say 'get_record_details with recordType record reads it'.

gaps.where: A record kept to its people (e.g. a Real Estate deal): the Assigned card with its main person and team
gaps.gap: get_record_details for a record returns name, kind, typeId, archived, notes and fields, but not keptToTeam, owner or team, which custom_record.get has and the Assigned card shows. No other read returns them (the records search gives only archivedAt). Meanwhile do_custom_record_assign and do_custom_record_unassign are offered.
gaps.fix: In tools-inbox-crm.ts getRecordDetails' record branch (1870-1885), add keptToTeam: record.keptToTeam and lookedAfterBy {main: owner {userId, name}, alsoOnIt: team [{userId, name}]}, as the person and company branch does (1860-1863).

gaps.where: Contacts → a kind's tab (Pets · N): the count on the tab, Show more, the Updated column
gaps.gap: find_records caps limit at 50, has no cursor, and drops custom_record.list's nextCursor. It doesn't return each kind's recordCount (from custom_record_type.list) or updatedAt. Its card title is count(items.length), so 'How many vehicles?' is answered from at most 50 rows without saying there are more.
gaps.fix: In find_records, take a cursor and return nextCursor and a 'more' note. Return recordCount on each kind (it's already in custom_record_type.list's output) and updatedAt on each record. Word the card title with '+' when nextCursor is set.

gaps.where: A record's page: Book (an appointment tied to the pet/vehicle/property), and its Appointments tab
gaps.gap: A repeat series can already be tied to a record: manage_repeat_visits takes customRecordId. A single booking can't: book_appointment (and update_appointment) take no customRecordId, although appointment.create does. list_appointments can't filter to a record's visits, although appointment.list takes customRecordId. So 'Book Max in Tuesday' books only the owner, and Max's Appointments tab can't be read.
gaps.fix: Add customRecordId to book_appointment (tools.ts:1345-1361) and pass it to appointment.create in its commit. Add customRecordId as a filter to list_appointments (tools-scheduling.ts:37-52) and pass it to appointment.list.

gaps.where: A customer's page: Text ▾ and Email ▾ when they have more than one number or email (each “number · Work” choice)
gaps.gap: send_text and send_email pick the target from personId (the main number, or their first text thread) or a conversationId. The Assistant can't text or email one of a person's other numbers or addresses unless a thread with it already exists, although message.send takes toPhone and toEmail. The screen's Text ▾ and Email ▾ offer each 'number · label'.
gaps.fix: Add an optional to to send_text (a phone from get_customer's phone or otherPhones) and to send_email (from email or otherEmails), checked against person.get. Pass toPhone or toEmail to message.send in the commits (tools-write.ts:399-405,494-500), and show 'To: (512) 555-0101 · Work' on the card.

gaps.where: A lead's ⋯ (Lead actions) menu: Edit details, Archive lead, Delete for good… (owners)
gaps.gap: The lead's ⋯ menu has Delete for good… for owners (lead-delete, on the web and the phone), and move_to_bin takes leads. But the places map says '⋯ has Edit details and Archive lead' and lists 'deleting a lead (archive it)' under Not in HandsFreeOS, and the prompt tells the model to say plainly that HandsFreeOS doesn't do anything on that list.
gaps.fix: In places-map.ts:224, change the ⋯ line to '⋯ has Edit details, Archive lead and Delete for good… (owners)'. Add the howTo 'Delete a lead for good: ⋯, then Delete for good… (owners); it waits 30 days in Settings → Deleted bin'. Remove notHere 'deleting a lead (archive it)' (line 235). Add 'delete it through the Deleted bin (owners)' to canChange.

gaps.where: A company's page and a record's page (pet, vehicle, property)
gaps.gap: The places map has no entry for a record's page. The company page is only 'the same, without calling, texting, booking or money' inside the customer page's entry. That leaves out the company's People list and Add person in Relationships, and wrongly implies Merge…, Calls from us, Regular services, Conversations, Workflows and Document are there. How to archive or book a pet, or where its buttons are, has nothing to go on.
gaps.fix: Add places entries 'A company’s page' (path /customers/companies/[companyId]): Note, Log call, Task, Lead, File; ⋯ Edit details, Archive, Delete for good… (owners); tabs; Assigned to, Open lead, Relationships with People and Add person. Add 'A record’s page' (path /customers/records/[recordId]): Book, Note, Task, File; ⋯ Edit details, Archive, Delete for good…; Appointments, Tasks and Files tabs; Assigned (when kept to its people) and Relationships.

gaps.where: A customer's page: the buttons along the top and the cards beside them
